beats.speaker: NARRATOR

beats.spokenText: Then he read the Hoh-kah-geh's whole archive and found a roster with one name inked out. He already knows which name fits.

beats.spokenText: [quiet] Everybody obeyed. It's the loneliest law the village ever wrote, and the man who wrote it is sitting very still.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I made that law. I can break it. I'm only asking myself whether I should.
beats.spokenText: I made that law. I can break it. I'm only asking myself whether I should.

beats.captionText: The old man has been lying for twelve years, for reasons he thought were good. Now he's counting his audience. A lie only works on one listener at a time.
beats.spokenText: The old man has been lying for twelve years, for reasons he thought were good. Now he's counting his audience. A lie only works on one listener at a time.

beats.captionText: Your mother was Kushina Uzumaki. Red hair, down to her waist. And a temper the whole village learned to respect.

beats.spokenText: A memory. And what do I get for it? Your face?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: A book. Just a book.
beats.spokenText: A book. Just a book.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: I don't read.
beats.spokenText: [flat] I don't read.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: You were reading the whole time. You said so. Did you think I wasn't reading too?
beats.spokenText: You were reading the whole time. You said so. Did you think I wasn't reading too?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The fox doesn't answer. For a creature who has spent centuries flattening mountains, he looks, for one moment, exactly like a customer caught browsing.
beats.spokenText: The fox doesn't answer. For a creature who has spent centuries flattening mountains, he looks, for one moment, exactly like a customer caught browsing.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: One chapter. If it's bad, you leave.
beats.spokenText: [grudging] One chapter. If it's bad, you leave.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: A clone sits down in the dark water before the largest cage in the world. Nobody asks how a clone gets in here. It's his own head. Mostly he's stopped asking.
beats.spokenText: A clone sits down in the dark water before the largest cage in the world. Nobody asks how a clone gets in here. It's his own head. Mostly he's stopped asking.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Chapter one. Chakra is the union of physical energy and spiritual energy.
beats.spokenText: Chapter one. chah-krah is the union of physical energy and spiritual energy.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Wrong. Obviously wrong.
beats.spokenText: [flat] Wrong. Obviously wrong.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: It's the first sentence!
beats.spokenText: It's the first sentence!

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Then the author has never met any. Continue.
beats.spokenText: Then the author has never met any. Continue.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He gets through three pages. The fox corrects four errors. Somewhere in the village, a tired boy is copying them into his margin.
beats.spokenText: [wry] He gets through three pages. The fox corrects four errors. Somewhere in the village, a tired boy is copying them into his margin.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Page nine says a beginner should aim for balance.
beats.spokenText: Page nine says a beginner should aim for balance.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Page nine was written by someone who has never held anything. Read it again. Slower.
beats.spokenText: Page nine was written by someone who has never held anything. Read it again. Slower.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By the third night the fox has stopped saying wrong and started saying again. A creature of pure hatred, listening to a beginner's primer. He'd sooner eat the book.
beats.spokenText: [dry] By the third night the fox has stopped saying wrong and started saying again. A creature of pure hatred, listening to a beginner's primer. He'd sooner eat the book.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Chapter two. Chakra control is the foundation of all ninja arts.
beats.spokenText: Chapter two. chah-krah control is the foundation of all ninja arts.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Chakra control is the foundation of not dying. Write that down.
beats.spokenText: chah-krah control is the foundation of not dying. Write that down.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, he wants us to write that down.
beats.spokenText: [muffled] Boss, he wants us to write that down.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Then write it down.
beats.spokenText: Then write it down.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Is there a villain in this book?
beats.spokenText: Is there a villain in this book?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: It's a chakra primer. The villain is poor posture.
beats.spokenText: [careful] It's a chah-krah primer. The villain is poor posture.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Hm. Poor posture. Continue.
beats.spokenText: Hm. Poor posture. Continue.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: You still want it. The night of the red sky.
beats.spokenText: You still want it. The night of the red sky.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Yes. All of it.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] Yes. All of it.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: I remember being angry. I've been angry for a very long time. But that night, the anger wasn't mine.
beats.spokenText: I remember being angry. I've been angry for a very long time. But that night, the anger wasn't mine.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: What does that mean?
beats.spokenText: What does that mean?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: A man in a mask. One red eye in the hole of it. And my own will, going out like a candle.
beats.spokenText: [slow] A man in a mask. One red eye in the hole of it. And my own will, going out like a candle.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: That's it?
beats.spokenText: That's it?

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: That's all I'll give you. One true memory. You want another, bring a better book.
beats.spokenText: That's all I'll give you. One true memory. You want another, bring a better book.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I'm not doing this because I like you.
beats.spokenText: [even] I'm not doing this because I like you.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Good. I'd be insulted.
beats.spokenText: Good. I'd be insulted.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The clone pops. Across the village, Naruto sits up in the dark holding a memory that isn't his. A mask. A fox who didn't choose. The seal didn't just break. Somebody was there. And that isn't in any file in the Leaf.
beats.spokenText: The clone pops. Across the village, Nah-roo-toh sits up in the dark holding a memory that isn't his. A mask. A fox who didn't choose. The seal didn't just break. Somebody was there. And that isn't in any file in the Leaf.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.captionText: Tomorrow, brat. And bring a book with a villain who wins.
beats.spokenText: [cavernous] Tomorrow, brat. And bring a book with a villain who wins.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Somebody else has noticed. Danzo, the Third's oldest rival, hears of a boy with the Nine-Tails, a jutsu that copies his mind, and the keys to the archive.
beats.spokenText: Somebody else has noticed. Dahn-zoh, the Third's oldest rival, hears of a boy with the Nine-Tails, a joot-soo that copies his mind, and the keys to the archive.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: To the Third, it's a lonely child with a filing job. To Danzo, it's a weapon left unattended in a library.
beats.spokenText: To the Third, it's a lonely child with a filing job. To Dahn-zoh, it's a weapon left unattended in a library.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Two in the morning. A man in a plain white mask walks into the archive. No village crest. No footsteps. He heads straight for the Namikaze box.
beats.spokenText: [ominous] Two in the morning. A man in a plain white mask walks into the archive. No village crest. No footsteps. He heads straight for the Namikaze box.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By the shelf stands a filing box. It's been there since yesterday. Nobody asked why. It's a clone, and it's having the worst shift of its life.
beats.spokenText: By the shelf stands a filing box. It's been there since yesterday. Nobody asked why. It's a clone, and it's having the worst shift of its life.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Do not move. You're a box. Boxes don't have opinions.
beats.spokenText: Do not move. You're a box. Boxes don't have opinions.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: He's reading the Uzumaki file. Why is he reading the Uzumaki file?
beats.spokenText: [whispering] He's reading the Oo-zoo-mah-kee file. Why is he reading the Oo-zoo-mah-kee file?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: He's writing in a little book. Boss is gonna want that little book.
beats.spokenText: He's writing in a little book. Boss is gonna want that little book.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: He's counting the boxes. There are forty. I'm number forty one. I don't match.
beats.spokenText: He's counting the boxes. There are forty. I'm number forty one. I don't match.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Root agent reads for an hour. Then, tired of standing, he does what nobody in the Leaf has ever done to a filing box. He sits on it.
beats.spokenText: [dry] The Root agent reads for an hour. Then, tired of standing, he does what nobody in the Leaf has ever done to a filing box. He sits on it.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss. A man is using me as a stool.
beats.spokenText: Boss. A man is using me as a stool.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Boxes make no noise. This one remembers his hands, his boots and every page he opened. When he leaves, the clone pops. The only witness was furniture.
beats.spokenText: Boxes make no noise. This one remembers his hands, his boots and every page he opened. When he leaves, the clone pops. The only witness was furniture.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Morning. The Hokage's office. Danzo doesn't knock. The Third doesn't look up from his pipe. Naruto, filing in the corner, does.
beats.spokenText: [even] Morning. The Hoh-kah-geh's office. Dahn-zoh doesn't knock. The Third doesn't look up from his pipe. Nah-roo-toh, filing in the corner, does.

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.captionText: Hiruzen. The Uzumaki boy should be trained properly. Root has the facilities.
beats.spokenText: Hee-roo-zen. The Oo-zoo-mah-kee boy should be trained properly. Root has the facilities.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: No. Absolutely not.
beats.spokenText: No. Absolutely not.

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.captionText: You've given the Nine-Tails a library card. A child with that much access is a risk.
beats.spokenText: [flat] You've given the Nine-Tails a library card. A child with that much access is a risk.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: He has a staff form, actually.
beats.spokenText: He has a staff form, actually.

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.captionText: A form is paper. I'll requisition him through the council. Today.
beats.spokenText: [cold] A form is paper. I'll requisition him through the council. Today.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Section three of the staff regulations. Office staff answer to the Hokage and no one else. Not the council. Not Root. Not you.
beats.spokenText: [calm] Section three of the staff regulations. Office staff answer to the Hoh-kah-geh and no one else. Not the council. Not Root. Not you.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I signed it twice by accident! Does that make it twice as binding?
beats.spokenText: I signed it twice by accident! Does that make it twice as binding?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I believe it does.
beats.spokenText: I believe it does.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Also, one of your guys sat on a filing box last night. It was me. I'd like an apology.
beats.spokenText: [innocent] Also, one of your guys sat on a filing box last night. It was me. I'd like an apology.

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.captionText: I don't know what you mean.
beats.spokenText: I don't know what you mean.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Plain mask. Boots like a wet sandwich. Sat on me for an hour.
beats.spokenText: Plain mask. Boots like a wet sandwich. Sat on me for an hour.

beats.speaker: DANZO
beats.captionText: He's a boy, Hiruzen.
beats.spokenText: [cold] He's a boy, Hee-roo-zen.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: He's my clerk.
beats.spokenText: He's my clerk.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Danzo has a hundred ways around a rule. He has none around a form. Weeks ago, the Third Hokage filed the one document in Konoha that Root can't requisition. The old man didn't punish him. He hired him.
beats.spokenText: [dry] Dahn-zoh has a hundred ways around a rule. He has none around a form. Weeks ago, the Third Hoh-kah-geh filed the one document in Koh-noh-hah that Root can't requisition. The old man didn't punish him. He hired him.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: He'll try again, Naruto.
beats.spokenText: [tired] He'll try again, Nah-roo-toh.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: I know. He'll have to fill out a form.
beats.spokenText: I know. He'll have to fill out a form.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: I'm very proud of that form.
beats.spokenText: I'm very proud of that form.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Danzo leaves without raising his voice. He doesn't look angry. He looks like a man who has simply moved the appointment.
beats.spokenText: [ominous] Dahn-zoh leaves without raising his voice. He doesn't look angry. He looks like a man who has simply moved the appointment.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The Third Hokage has an idea. Keep Team Seven busy and inside the village. So he hands them D-ranks. Weeding. Painting. Babysitting. And the occasional lost cat.
beats.spokenText: The Third Hoh-kah-geh has an idea. Keep Team Seven busy and inside the village. So he hands them D-ranks. Weeding. Painting. Babysitting. And the occasional lost cat.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Naruto sends two hundred clones. By noon, twelve missions are done. By three, twenty-nine. Every garden in Konoha has been weeded by someone with the same face.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh sends two hundred clones. By noon, twelve missions are done. By three, twenty-nine. Every garden in Koh-noh-hah has been weeded by someone with the same face.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: He hasn't gotten one ounce stronger. He has simply brought more of himself. Years from now he'll run the whole Hokage's office this way. Today it's the mission board.
beats.spokenText: [dry] He hasn't gotten one ounce stronger. He has simply brought more of himself. Years from now he'll run the whole Hoh-kah-geh's office this way. Today it's the mission board.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Eleven of the forty missions are the same cat. Tora, the Daimyo's wife's cat, escapes every week, and every week a team loses an afternoon and some skin.
beats.spokenText: [dry] Eleven of the forty missions are the same cat. Tora, the Daimyo's wife's cat, escapes every week, and every week a team loses an afternoon and some skin.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Boss, found the cat. Again.
beats.spokenText: Boss, found the cat. Again.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Again? What number is this?
beats.spokenText: [tired] Again? What number is this?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Eleven. We know his hiding places better than he does.
beats.spokenText: Eleven. We know his hiding places better than he does.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: By the eleventh capture, the cat has given up. The Daimyo's wife squeezes it until its eyes go dead, and for once the whole room agrees with the cat.
beats.spokenText: By the eleventh capture, the cat has given up. The Daimyo's wife squeezes it until its eyes go dead, and for once the whole room agrees with the cat.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Weeding, done. Painting, done. Grocery run for the Akimichi clan, done.
beats.spokenText: [hoarse] Weeding, done. Painting, done. Grocery run for the Akimichi clan, done.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: That one was hard. They noticed we ate the potato chips.
beats.spokenText: That one was hard. They noticed we ate the potato chips.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Naruto. I notice the missions are finished before I find out what they are.
beats.spokenText: Nah-roo-toh. I notice the missions are finished before I find out what they are.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Efficiency, sensei!
beats.spokenText: [bright] Efficiency, sen-say!

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: I've read four chapters. Don't stop on my account.
beats.spokenText: I've read four chapters. Don't stop on my account.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: Team Seven. Forty D-ranks. In one day. That's the entire board.
beats.spokenText: Team Seven. Forty D-ranks. In one day. That's the entire board.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: I can't feel my arms.
beats.spokenText: [dazed] I can't feel my arms.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Tch. Is that all there is?
beats.spokenText: Tch. Is that all there is?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: I'm up to chapter nine. Excellent day.
beats.spokenText: I'm up to chapter nine. Excellent day.

beats.speaker: IRUKA
beats.captionText: There are no more D-ranks. I'm out. I looked under the desk.
beats.spokenText: [pleading] There are no more D-ranks. I'm out. I looked under the desk.

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: Then I suppose it's time for something harder. A C-rank. An escort.
beats.spokenText: Then I suppose it's time for something harder. A C-rank. An escort.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Who's the client, old man?
beats.spokenText: Who's the client, old man?

beats.speaker: HIRUZEN
beats.captionText: A bridge builder from the Land of Waves. He's paying the going rate for a C-rank.
beats.spokenText: [even] A bridge builder from the Land of Waves. He's paying the going rate for a C-rank.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.captionText: Finally.
beats.spokenText: Finally.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: That night in the archive, Naruto reads the part of the bingo book nobody reads. The appendix. The Hidden Mist's procedure for hunting their own missing ninja. It's written like a recipe.
beats.spokenText: That night in the archive, Nah-roo-toh reads the part of the bingo book nobody reads. The appendix. The Hidden Mist's procedure for hunting their own missing ninja. It's written like a recipe.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Step one, find the missing-nin. Step two, finish the missing-nin. Step three, destroy the body where it falls.
beats.spokenText: [reading] Step one, find the missing-nin. Step two, finish the missing-nin. Step three, destroy the body where it falls.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: There's a diagram. A body, a flame, and an arrow that says, here.
beats.spokenText: There's a diagram. A body, a flame, and an arrow that says, here.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Why where it falls?
beats.spokenText: Why where it falls?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: Secrets. A hunter never carries the body home. It says so four times. Underlined twice.
beats.spokenText: [reading] Secrets. A hunter never carries the body home. It says so four times. Underlined twice.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.captionText: And somebody wrote in the margin, I mean it.
beats.spokenText: And somebody wrote in the margin, I mean it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: So they burn it right there. Nobody drags a body forty miles. I respect that.
beats.spokenText: So they burn it right there. Nobody drags a body forty miles. I respect that.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: It's the most boring paragraph in the book. Naruto folds the corner of the page anyway. Boring paragraphs are where the useful things hide.
beats.spokenText: [dry] It's the most boring paragraph in the book. Nah-roo-toh folds the corner of the page anyway. Boring paragraphs are where the useful things hide.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: The next morning, at the village gate. Team Seven, one jonin, and a bridge builder from the Land of Waves, with a hat, a bottle and a very calm face.
beats.spokenText: The next morning, at the village gate. Team Seven, one joh-nin, and a bridge builder from the Land of Waves, with a hat, a bottle and a very calm face.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.captionText: I'm just a simple bridge builder. Nothing exciting is going to happen on this trip. I promise.
beats.spokenText: I'm just a simple bridge builder. Nothing exciting is going to happen on this trip. I promise.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.captionText: That's what a C-rank is, right? Nothing exciting?
beats.spokenText: [bright] That's what a C-rank is, right? Nothing exciting?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.captionText: Stay close. It's an escort. Nothing dangerous. Probably.
beats.spokenText: Stay close. It's an escort. Nothing dangerous. Probably.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: They walk out under the gate. For the first hour Naruto is quiet, which worries Kakashi more than any noise could. Behind them, a hundred clones hold the archive. Ahead, a long dry road.
beats.spokenText: They walk out under the gate. For the first hour Nah-roo-toh is quiet, which worries Kah-kah-shee more than any noise could. Behind them, a hundred clones hold the archive. Ahead, a long dry road.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.captionText: Dust. Cracked mud. Not a cloud since last week. And in the middle of the road, sitting there as if somebody left it behind, is a puddle.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] Dust. Cracked mud. Not a cloud since last week. And in the middle of the road, sitting there as if somebody left it behind, is a puddle.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.captionText: Sensei. It hasn't rained in a week.
beats.spokenText: [quiet] sen-say. It hasn't rained in a week.
